title: Spice Girls’ Mel B teases launch of her own curl-focused hair care brand
summary: Melanie Janine Brown, who went by ‘Scary Spice’ in award-winning UK girl group Spice Girls, has teamed up with celebrity hairdresser Rory McPhee to create a hair range, MPWR, focused on ‘achieving healthy curls, simplified’, which will debut next year
